items.note:
It's built — MUR reports has its own tab now, right next to Certified payroll, in the same Documents group.

Click into any client's MUR reports tab: "+ Add report period" starts a tracked entry (project, period dates), then you can either Upload the finished file to store it there, or hit Email to send it straight from the app — same as certified payroll's email panel, attaching whatever's uploaded. There's a notes box at the top of the list, saved for the whole team, same "where do these go" note certified payroll already has.

One thing I did NOT build yet: filling out the report template itself inside the app (the demographic/hours grid, matching the state's Excel template). You flagged you weren't sure about that one yourself, and it's a bigger, separate piece — I'd rather build that carefully on its own than rush the compliance math in alongside the tracker. This ships everything else you described: the notes, the upload-or-email, storing the files. Let me know if you want me to take on the template next.
